findings.summary: VI-R9-001 is closed. Repository-changing caller Git variables no longer redirect validation, and trustworthy command-scoped core settings are applied.
Direct NUL-safe HEAD-tree verification rejects same-size/same-mtime tracked-byte edits, while lstat-based comparison rejects tracked executable-mode drift.
The remote frozen commit, tree and replayed reviewed-content digest are exact, and a legitimate metadata-only READY/ACCEPT descendant passes canonical validation.
Prior dirty-state, committed allowlist, frozen control/history, lifecycle, acceptance, identifier and capability controls remain fail closed.
All 76 focused tests, Release Check and all 10 pull-request workflow runs pass; protected scopes and ancestry remain intact.

commands: verify remote pull-request head, branch, commit, tree and ancestry
construct and validate legitimate metadata-only READY/ACCEPT descendant
confirm caller Git context cannot redirect dirty-state validation
confirm direct HEAD-tree hashing rejects same-size/same-mtime byte drift
confirm lstat rejects tracked executable-mode drift
retest dirty state, frozen controls/history, lifecycle, acceptance and capability boundaries
verify 10 pull-request workflow runs, protected scopes and git diff --check
conclusion: The targeted Git-context regressions are closed, a legitimate READY/ACCEPT transition succeeds, prior controls remain effective, and validator-integrity is READY with no open critical or material findings.
